features.title: Run OpenCode plugin tools and tool hooks
features.summary: Tools an OpenCode plugin adds through ctx.tool.transform become DSH agent tools; its execute.before and execute.after hooks run on every DSH tool call, denying calls or replacing result content.
features.currentSurface: agent tools contributed by configured plugins
failureModes: A tool whose input schema cannot become object JSON Schema is not registered and is listed in opencode_plugins_status.
A before-hook that rewrites tool input denies the call, because DSH freezes arguments (Host gap 112).

verification.testName: runs and reloads compat tools and hooks in the real tool runtime
